Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “古代的时候” / Formula: 在 + historical time period / Correct: “在古代”   “古代的时候” is understandable, but “在古代” is more concise and natural in narration.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “有一个人叫神农” / Formula: 有一个 + 叫 + name + 的 + person / Correct: “在古代，有一个叫神农的人。”   This introduces the main character more naturally when he first appears.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农正在路上走” / Formula: Subject + 在 + place + verb / Correct: “神农正在路上走。” → “神农正在路上走” is understandable, but “神农正在路上走” should preferably be “神农正在路上走着” or, more naturally, “神农正在路上走。”   For a location, use “在路上”; your sentence already has this structure, so it is basically correct. “走着” can make the ongoing action more vivid.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一看很多人正在吃一些植物” / Formula: Subject + 看到 + object / Correct: “他看到很多人正在吃一些植物。”   “一看” usually means “as soon as one looks” and needs a clearer structure. Here, 神农 simply *saw* something, so “看到” is better.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农想帮别人。所以想知道……” / Formula: Subject + 想 + verb；所以 + result / Correct: “神农想帮助人们，所以他想知道哪些植物可以吃，哪些植物不能吃。”   Do not separate “所以” from the result in this way. Adding “他” also makes the subject clear.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines two time expressions; “在古代” is correct.
“有一个人叫神农” is already a grammatical and acceptable character introduction.
“神农正在路上走” is grammatical, and the purported correction does not actually change it.
“一看很多人……” is not a well-formed observation clause here; “他看到很多人……” is correct.
“别人” wrongly refers to others as opposed to the speaker, and “所以” should link directly to its result clause.
